diseases.description: A viral tomato disease transmitted by whiteflies; infected plants can become stunted and produce fewer fruits.
symptoms: Upward curling and yellowing of leaf margins
Smaller leaves and shortened internodes
Stunted plant growth
Reduced fruit set
causes: Infection by Tomato yellow leaf curl virus
The virus is transmitted by infected whiteflies, especially Bemisia tabaci

chemical_management.option: No verified chemical option is available in the current knowledge base.
chemical_management.reason: A disease-specific product label and current local registration have not been verified for this project. Do not infer or apply a pesticide from this prediction.

cultural_management.option: Follow the preventive and crop-care measures listed for this disease.
cultural_management.reason: These are general monitoring, sanitation or crop-care measures. Confirm suitability with a local agricultural extension professional.
cultural_management.source: University of Minnesota Extension – Tomato viruses

preventive_measures: Use healthy virus-free transplants.
Monitor whiteflies and follow local integrated pest-management guidance.
Seek expert confirmation before removing plants.
